B2.title: Valerie
B2.visualDescription: Focused executive practicing deep work techniques at a minimal wooden desk with an hourglass.

pages.bio: I'm Valerie, 30. As a strategy consultant, I structure my workday around uninterrupted 90-minute 'deep work' blocks, eliminating notifications to maximize cognitive output and flow state.
I optimize my circadian rhythm by getting direct sunlight exposure within 15 minutes of waking, delaying caffeine intake by two hours, and using dim red light spectrums before sleep.
Every evening I practice Stoic journaling, reflecting on what was within my control and mentally rehearsing potential challenges for the upcoming day to cultivate emotional tranquility.
